meta.description: DFL reference distributions for the Linesman realism report (synthetic vs real)
meta.source: DFL/Sportec open data: Bassek, M., Rein, R., Weber, H., Memmert, D. (2025). An integrated dataset of spatiotemporal and event data in elite soccer. Scientific Data 12:195. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04505-y. Licence: CC-BY 4.0. Aggregate statistics only; no raw, frame-level or person-level data.
meta.licence: CC-BY 4.0 (data); these aggregates are derived statistics with attribution

config.xg_angle_slope_source: Soccermatics angle-only logistic fit, logit(xG) = -3.52 + 2.84 * theta, on 8,451 shots of the 2017/18 Premier League in the open Wyscout data (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236, doi:10.1038/s41597-019-0247-7, CC BY 4.0)

conventions.coordinates: metres, centre origin, team-attacking direction: the team attacks +x, left is +y; pitch 105 x 68 m
conventions.validity: valid samples only (valid_kinematics = true); estimated gap samples never count for speed, peaks or per-90 values
conventions.per90: normalised on measured (valid) time of each player-match (team decision 2026-10-24); see coverage
conventions.ball: ball status and possession are the provider's (never derived from a stationary ball)

notes: Reference of the Linesman realism report (guidelines section 12; data_pipeline/insidethegame_data/realism.py). Every metric is computed by realism_metrics.match_samples on the frame-level outputs of the preparation pipeline, the same code that runs on the synthetic matches.

quantiles: the 21 quantiles at quantile_levels_pct (p2.5, p5, p10, p15, ..., p90, p95, p97.5; linear interpolation) of the values pooled over the matches. No minimum (p0) and no maximum (p100) are stored (privacy, team decision 2026-10-25). Known limit, accepted (guidelines section 19; CC-BY aggregates): with linear interpolation a stored quantile can coincide with one value, when its position p x (n - 1) / 100 is a whole number, and a per-match median of an odd number of player-matches is one player-match value. The reference CDF is linear between these quantiles, 0 below p2.5 and 1 from p97.5: against the full DFL distribution it is off by at most 0.025 in each tail and by at most the spacing of two stored levels (0.05) between them, and so is the KS distance D. match_median_range: min and max of the per-match medians (matches with at least one value). n: pooled values. No person or object IDs are stored; match IDs appear only in meta.

comparison: ks_and_range = many values per match (player-matches, passes, shots, ball samples, live phases, possession spells, team frames): one-sample KS distance against the reference CDF plus the median rule; range_only = one value per match or per team-match: with 6 matches a KS test is meaningless, only the median rule applies.

Physical metrics: player-matches with >= 60 valid minutes, per 90 minutes of measured time (as physical_profiles.json), by realism role group: GK = GK (n = 12); CB = CB (n = 26); FB = FB (n = 21); MF = DM+CM+AM (n = 31); W = W (n = 20); ST = ST (n = 17). DM, CM (2 DFL player-matches) and AM (9) are merged into MF: CM and AM are too small for a distribution.

Accelerations / decelerations: runs of consecutive valid samples with tangential acceleration above +3 / below -3 m/s2 lasting >= 0.5 s (R-ACC-BAND noise samples have no acceleration). A realism metric only, never an outlier rule (guidelines section 8).

Events per team: the team attribute of the event (Team, else WinnerTeam, else TeamFouler, as event_model.json); per 90 minutes of match time (sum of the tracked period durations). Clearances are the pipeline's event_kind 'clearance' (OtherBallAction with DefensiveClearance = true). Shot outcomes are the annotated labels mapped to English (section 16.3; OtherShot -> wide).

Passes: located open-play passes; success = next touch by a team-mate (trajectory, R-PASS-OUTCOME), by the third of the kick location (attacking coordinates). Team shape: outfield players only, max - min of x (length) and y (width), scaled to 105 x 68 m.

This file can be written alone, leaving the other calibration files untouched: python -m insidethegame_data.calibration --repo <work dir> --out ../calibration --only realism_reference.json, where <work dir> holds the qc outputs (qc --reports-dir <work dir>/reports/qc; the Linesman uses reports/qc/frames/_realism). input_hashes identify the frame-level files it was built from.

diagnostics.shot_outcome_label_vs_observed: shots by annotated outcome label (English) and by the outcome the pipeline observes on the trajectory (R-SHOT-OUTCOME, R-WOODWORK; 'none' = no coherent outcome or not located), pooled counts.
